name: Mereoleona Pins
description: Pin/freeze windows: always-on-top + locked size + stacking, with an ice-freeze animation. Dashboard from the top bar.

name: Mereoleona Spectrum
description: Fire audio spectrum visualizer in the top bar, driven by cava.

name: Mereoleona Launcher
description: Spotlight-style quick launcher in the top bar. Run scripts and commands from a JSON config.

name: Mereoleona Lyrics
description: Synced karaoke lyrics in your terminal. Fire gradient scrolling display. Fetches from lrclib.net.

name: Lyrics Overlay
description: Single-line GTK overlay showing the current lyric with a fire sweep animation. No terminal needed.

name: Mereoleona Timer
description: Task timer with Jira ticket tracking, pause/resume, daily logs, and table export.

name: Mereo Standup
description: Reads yesterday's timer log and formats a standup message. Copies to clipboard automatically.

name: Mereoleona Viz
description: Fire audio visualizer rendered in the terminal using cava.
